                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean containsType(String inputType, String... types) {
        for (String token : inputType.split("\\|")) {
            String trimmed = token.trim();
            for (String type : types) {
                if (trimmed.contains(type)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
